cer-blocks.alt: Three stacked blocks. Claim: catalase works fastest near pH 7. Evidence: 4.8 mL O₂ per minute at pH 7, compared with 2.1 at pH 5 and 3.0 at pH 9, with non-overlapping error bars. Reasoning: pH changes the charges on R groups in the active site, changing its shape and how well it binds substrate. Arrows show evidence supporting the claim and reasoning linking them.
